Get Twinprice ↓

TWINPRICE ON YOUR PHONE

Convert prices on your phone with Firefox for Android

Most phone browsers, including Chrome, can’t add extensions. Firefox for Android can, and Twinprice is available there.

Install Twinprice on Android

  1. Install Firefox for Android from Google Play. Twinprice needs version 142 or later.
  2. In Firefox on your phone, open Twinprice on Firefox Add-ons and tap Add to Firefox.
  3. Confirm when Firefox asks.

Use it while you shop

Open a shop in Firefox. When Twinprice finds prices, it offers to convert them. To open Twinprice itself, open the Firefox menu, choose Extensions and then Twinprice.

It is the same extension as on a computer, with the same currencies and settings, so the user guide applies.

On an iPhone or iPad?

Browsers on iPhone and iPad can’t add Twinprice, Firefox included. Use it on a computer in Chrome or Firefox, or on an Android phone.
